specification.title: Webbing, Textile, Woven Nylon
specification.distribution: Commercial specification, adopted from military document
specification.scope: Requirements for woven, untreated nylon webbing. Covers 31 distinct types across Class 1 (shuttle loom) and Class 1A (shuttleless loom).
specification.notes: COMPLETE RE-INGESTION DIRECTLY FROM PIA-W-4088G PDF — 31 types, 62 variants, exact Table I CA color numbers, Table IV/V physicals, Table III weaves, Table VI defect codes, and Table VII sampling.

defects.defect: Abrasion marks - rupture of yarns or nap obscuring yarn identity, >10% width or 1-in length
Yarns (filling) - two yarns per shed, Class 1 only
Broken or missing end - two or more, or single end ≥6in
Broken or missing end - single end <6in but >1/4in
Broken or missing pick - two or more regardless of extent
Coarse or light filling bar - visible stiffness/thickness difference, >1/4in length
Coarse or light filling bar - visible stiffness/thickness difference, ≤1/4in length
Twist or distortion - webbing will not lay flat under manual pressure
Cut, hole, or tear - any
Drop-ply - visible on >2 ends, extending >9 linear inches
Drop-ply - visible on 1-2 ends, extending >9 linear inches
Edges - frayed, slack, tight, or poorly constructed, >1/4in length
Floats or skips - 3+, ½in or more combined warp/filling
Floats or skips - 3+, less than ½in combined warp/filling
Floats or skips - single float/skip >1in
Floats or skips - single float/skip ½-1in in warp
Floats or skips - single float/skip 1/4-1in in filling
Hitchback crack - visible opening between picks or warp tension area
Jerked-in filling - pulled in at edges
Kinks - more than 3 in any linear inch
Knots - more than 1 in any 9 linear inches
Knots - one every 2yd with untrimmed ends extending from surface
Mispick, double pick - two or more across full width
Mispick, double pick - single across full width
Slack end - two or more, jerked in or forming visible loops
Slack end - single jerked in or forming visible loops
Slub, slug or gout - more than twice yarn thickness
Smash - any
Spot, stain or streak - any clearly visible
Tight end - clearly visible up to 12in length
Wrong draw - extending more than 9in
Dropped knitted stitch on edge (shuttleless looms only)
Lock stitch missing (shuttleless looms only)
